reviews.text:
We recently worked with Watercrest Pools to design and build a custom Spool (a combination of pool, spa, and water feature) and an elevated patio — and the entire experience was outstanding from start to finish!

From our very first meeting, Greg Neppl and his team truly understood our vision. We had spent time sketching a design based on the Golden Ratio, with flowing, organic lines to complement our home and wooded surroundings. Greg took those sketches and turned them into a stunning 3D architectural plan that perfectly captured what we had envisioned.

The build process was smooth, efficient, and enjoyable. The entire crew was professional, courteous, and highly skilled. Brian Pucci, the onsite foreman, deserves special recognition — he was thoughtful, communicative, and meticulous throughout the project. His attention to detail and craftsmanship made a significant impact and kept the project on track from start to finish.

A special mention also goes to Mike Buckman, the master stone mason who built our six-foot custom stone retaining wall for the elevated patio. His precision and artistry were remarkable — the entire wall is perfectly level and beautifully finished, showcasing true craftsmanship in custom stonework.

We were also impressed by Watercrest’s ability to handle the city inspection process with professionalism and creativity. Their expertise and persistence ensured everything moved forward smoothly despite several challenging requirements.

Our new Spool and patio turned out even better than we imagined — elegant, functional, and seamlessly integrated with our outdoor living space. We highly recommend Watercrest Pools, Greg Neppl, and the entire team for anyone seeking exceptional pool design, quality construction, and masterful stonework.
reviews.author: Dean

reviews.text: We had an absolutely awesome experience with Watercrest! We redid out pool and patio, adding a jacuzzi, firepit and outdoor kitchen. Even with all the rain in May, they were able to complete the job to useable status in time for my parents 60th anniversary party. The backyard is beautiful! From the design process with Greg, to the material selection with Fiorella, the actual crazy redo with Anthony and the finish work with AJ, we are extremely pleased and so glad we went with Watercrest! This was a big job and they came through on every request!  The photos show a still in progress backyard, but we are almost done!
reviews.author: Chris Kettner

reviews.text: Exceeded our expectations! Our pool was finished four months ago but I thought it would be worthwhile to wait until it was operating awhile before giving a review. This way I can speak to the project installation as well as the reliability of the equipment and the quality of Watercrest's service. Working with Watercrest was a really good experience from start to finish. Sam and his team have a well oiled design and selection process....makes it easy to connect the pool's design and content to your vision and budget. The construction process went remarkably smoothly. Our project manager, Brian, did a great job of coordinating the different crews needed to make our pool a reality. He communicated frequently and so we had very few surprises as the project came together. That is a major accomplishment by itself!  If you haven't built a pool before, the project will run from 4 to 6 months, so you're spending a lot of time looking out of the window at construction when you just want to go swimming :-)  Watercrest was excellent at navigating the inevitable delays of weather issues or supplier back orders to get us in the water as quickly as possible. They do enough pools so they are able to get things done when others not as large may get stuck. When they finished and turned the pool on AJ walked us through the equipment, scheduled "pool school" and made certain we could operate the pool directly or on our phones. Our only service issue was a dropped connection between the pool equipment and the Pentair mobile app. AJ got that squared away quickly. Otherwise, the pool has been "bullet proof", even during the most recent freeze. Overall, its easy to recommend Watercrest to you and to say they "exceeded our expectations!"
reviews.author: Louis Myers

reviews.text: Watercrest pools was absolutely amazing from start to finish with our pool. Brian our project manager made sure everything was done correctly and fixed anything that went wrong, quickly and efficiently. We LOVE our backyard now thanks to them! You will not regret picking this company to build your dream pool!
reviews.author: Chelsee Smith

reviews.text: Sam, Greg, A.J. and Sam's entire team at Watercrest Pools are amazing!  They made the entire process so easy; they are all incredibly responsive and they truly care about the product they deliver!  Sam was able to take our design thoughts/ideas and come up with a beautiful design which he put into a 3D design program; it was even better than we imagined, on the first try!  We couldn't be happier!  Thanks so much Watercrest Pools!
reviews.author: Kim Weitz

reviews.text: Building our pool with Watercrest was a fantastic experience from design to startup. Sam, Greg, Ryan and AJ are all accessible, knowledgeable and committed to your satisfaction. Any and all concerns have been addressed and resolved expeditiously. I have high expectations (and am extremely particular with high quality specs and attention to detail) when selecting contractors and would confidently recommend Watercrest. They use Pentair which I am overall already impressed with over Jandy on our previous pool. The biggest difference from out last pool builder in Houston to Watercrest is the after startup customer service. Overall top notch company to work with.
reviews.author: Evan Feldman

reviews.text: Watercrest completed our pool about six months ago. It turned out beautiful, and any issue that we had was addressed promptly. I feel that I can contact them any time even after business hours and receive a  timely response. AJ provides great service!
reviews.author: Deepal Patel

reviews.text: Watercrest finished our pool in May of 2024. We did our homework, knew what we wanted and they came through with a quality product.  Enjoyed working with the staff and they were on top of every aspect though out the build. If we were to build again they would be first on our list.
reviews.author: Doug Sherar
